idea.title: Wave Ledger
idea.hook: The next 3 enemy waves are shown face-up like cards — spend repositioning tokens to reshuffle your defenders between waves, but tokens only refill when a wave deals zero damage.
idea.hook_ru: Следующие 3 волны врагов открыты, как карты — трать жетоны перестановки, чтобы пересобрать защиту между волнами, но жетоны пополняются, только если волна не нанесла урона.
idea.prototype: Deterministic tabletop tower defense on an 8x5 grid. Defenders are placed at level start. Between every wave a panel deals the NOW / NEXT / AFTER waves face-up as icon-count cards (full pre-visibility). The player DRAGS defender tiles to new cells (1 repositioning token per move), then taps RESOLVE to run the wave as a pre-computed calculation (animated but pre-determined — no twitch/aiming). A zero-damage defense refunds +2 tokens; each leaked enemy costs base HP. Win = survive the 16-wave campaign; lose = base HP reaches 0. Six enemy types (grunt, armored brute, swarm, flyer, self-healing mender, colossus boss) and five defender types (single-target cannon, splash mage, line/anti-air archer, slow frost, chain) make every placement a counter-puzzle; a new enemy type or twist is telegraphed every 1-2 waves.
idea.mutation_of: Растения против зомби / AOD - Art Of Defense / Necrofort (TD dominates strategy charts), reframed as a turn-based, NO-timer, full-pre-visibility deterministic TD whose pressure is a repositioning-token economy + base HP
idea.why_novel: First fully deterministic, turn-based, no-aim tower defense in the gallery — every TD-adjacent mechanic elsewhere is real-time. The face-up next-3-waves cards turn a TD into a readable planning puzzle, and the token economy that only refills on a PERFECT (zero-leak) wave makes positioning a scarce-resource optimisation rather than spam-placement. No countdown timer anywhere.
idea.non_timer_pressure: Resource scarcity (repositioning tokens — only refill +2 on a zero-damage wave) + lives (base HP, never regenerates). Zero countdown timer.
idea.lose_condition: baseHP <= 0 after a wave resolves -> gs = 'GAMEOVER'

sources.snippet: The cover uses the danger_combat archetype steered off the daily ctr-swipe set: a wave of enemies crashing toward a braced defense line, high contrast, saturated foreground, face-up next-wave cards visible.

synthesizer_brief: A deterministic, turn-based tower defense built as a tabletop planning puzzle. On an 8x5 grid the player sees the next THREE enemy waves dealt face-up as icon-count cards, drags pre-placed defenders to new cells at a cost of 1 repositioning token per move, then taps RESOLVE to run the wave as a pre-computed (animated but pre-determined) calculation — no aiming, no twitch. Tokens are scarce and ONLY refill (+2) when a wave leaks zero enemies, so the loop pushes toward optimal positioning. Each leaked enemy chips base HP; base HP at 0 = GAMEOVER; clearing all 16 escalating waves = WIN. Depth comes from a counter-matrix: 6 enemy types (grunt, armored brute needing concentrated fire, swarm punishing single-target, flyer only some defenders hit, self-healing mender needing focus-kill, colossus boss) vs 5 defender types (single-target cannon, splash/anti-air mage, line/anti-air archer, slow frost, chain). A new enemy type or twist is telegraphed every 1-2 waves with a clear difficulty ramp and two boss waves (8 and 16). Pressure is purely economic (tokens) + attrition (HP) — no timer. Mutates the timeless TD genre (PvZ / Art Of Defense / Necrofort) into a no-aim, full-pre-visibility, scarce-token planning game. Validated by the 2026-06-06 Tavily #1 PokéPath TD and the ctr-swipe TD/idle cluster.

alternatives.title: Pose Crash
alternatives.hook: A ragdoll crumples on impact — use a limited number of joint clicks to match the translucent target silhouette before the judge scores you.
alternatives.why_not: Sibling new-build this run went to Wave Ledger (the strategy pick); Pose Crash is the physics pick and may be built in a later slot.

alternatives.title: Gear Trap
alternatives.hook: Unscrew every bolt — but turn one and its four orthogonal neighbors tighten like gears; over-tighten any single bolt and it seizes forever, making the board unsolvable.
alternatives.why_not: Prototype_only this cycle; tight constraint-propagation puzzle, lower CTR (52) than the TD cover.

alternatives.title: Crater Golf
alternatives.hook: Fire shots that permanently pit the terrain — you have 5 shots per hole and must route the final ball into the cup via craters your first four shots carved.
alternatives.why_not: Prototype_only; strong novelty (82) but needs destructible-terrain physics that exceed a single deterministic-grid session budget.

alternatives.title: Silk Snare
alternatives.hook: You're a spider with a fixed silk budget — draw thread segments between anchor pegs to build a web that intercepts every incoming fly before your silk runs out.
alternatives.why_not: Prototype_only; a budget-drawing interception puzzle — overlaps Wave Ledger's scarce-resource framing, so deferred to avoid same-cycle redundancy.
